mapper.select: SELECT d.name AS name, COUNT(s.sid) AS value FROM department d LEFT JOIN clazz c ON d.did = c.did LEFT JOIN student s ON c.cid = s.cid GROUP BY d.did, d.name ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT sex AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM student WHERE sex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sex
SELECT age AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM student WHERE age IS NOT NULL GROUP BY age ORDER BY age
SELECT c.name AS name, ROUND(AVG(s.total), 1) AS value FROM score s LEFT JOIN course c ON s.course_id = c.course_id GROUP BY s.course_id, c.name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT CASE WHEN total >= 90 THEN '优秀' WHEN total >= 80 THEN '良好' WHEN total >= 60 THEN '及格' ELSE '不及格' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM score GROUP BY CASE WHEN total >= 90 THEN '优秀' WHEN total >= 80 THEN '良好' WHEN total >= 60 THEN '及格' ELSE '不及格' END
SELECT week_day AS weekDay, section AS section, COUNT(*) AS value FROM course_arrange GROUP BY week_day, section ORDER BY week_day, section
SELECT username, operation, create_time AS createTime FROM operation_log ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 10
